long_description: Theo is an AI agent that builds your small business website in minutes, then works on it every week so customers find you, whether they search Google themselves or ask an AI. launches.tagline: Search is changing. The days of getting 30 pages of Google results (that you never scroll through anyway) are over. Today, AI agents give customers three choices. Max. Theo helps make sure your business is one of them.
launches.body:
<https://youtu.be/asxjV4jlCTY?si=gae61cXG75s7I2Kt>

**WHAT IS THEO?**

Theo is like having an expert professional web guru working for you 24 hours a day. Those aren’t our words but the words of one of our customers. Theo is constantly analyzing where your potential customers are coming from and what they are searching for. Theo writes and publishes content automatically so you’re getting consistently ranked and your domain authority rises.

We’ve built 10,000+ sites since July with an average increase of over 50% in traffic and generated 100s of thousands of impressions.

**OUR TARGET**

Anyone who runs a small to medium sized business and has been frustrated by where they rank on search.

**CHECK IT OUT**

Take the Theo test. Paste any small business website into [theo.site/audit](http://theo.site/audit) and see whether search can find it and what you need to improve your results. It takes two minutes, with no login.

**HOW MUCH IT COSTS**

A web guy will charge you $150 an hour to do anything. Theo charges $69.99 a month to do everything. It’ll build you a site in minutes and update it continually and intelligently. It publishes content to keep your site fresh. Theo does what an SEO agency does but better and automatically and without a $1,000 monthly retainer.

**ABOUT THE FOUNDER**

Miles Pines is a solo founder with a Harvard CS degree. Before Theo, he co-founded Endgrate and bootstrapped it to $100k+ a year in revenue. Previously, he worked on low-latency software at Citadel Securities.

Miles learned SEO the hard way at Endgrate. He took a product nobody had heard of to thousands of organic clicks a month. Then friends who own businesses asked him to do the same for them, and Miles found himself doing the exact same work every week, for every one of them. That work never ends, and most small businesses can't afford to pay someone to do it forever. So he built Theo: the agent that does it for them.

**THE ASK**

If you run a small business, or know someone who does, run the free audit at [https://theo.site](https://theo.site/)

Try the product for free.

Introductions to people who serve lots of small businesses: accountants, marketing agencies, chambers of commerce, franchise groups, and business banks.

Reach me at [miles@theo.site](mailto:miles@theo.site)

Thank you!

Miles
